note: Read-only audit. All 62 cases are not_run in acceptance-cases.json. No e2e or story run has a recorded pass or fail on disk. evidence_on_disk means a deterministic in-repo test observes the requirement and the oracle does not name a live service, manual run or browser matrix. needs_live_stack means the oracle names a live host or browser matrix. Lower-class tests are cited as partial evidence. A caveats array may qualify an evidence_on_disk case. The working tree has uncommitted changes.

cases.title: Semantic inspection and approval provenance

evidence.name_or_line: model-origin approval refused with the actor named
evidence.observes: Provenance at the model.
Semantic tree is published as a feed.
workbench.read (tree, catalogue, subtree, size cut, not drawn yet) and workbench.act (run id from the request, each refusal code reaches the receipt, unmounted, throwing handle), each answered once.

Through the real wasm and the page path: read tree and catalogue, act focuses a tab from the tree, human_only and unknown_panel refused, an effect carries actor agent with the run id and a person's typing carries none, an over-long read is cut and followed by next, unmounted turn declares nothing and is answered not on screen.

gaps: No browser approval run: the story drives the agent's act on a human-only action (refused) but not a person approving.
The accessible overlay is another piece of work; the agent reads the tree through workbench.read, not through the overlay.
The page half is proven against the real wasm in a fixture story, not against a live Theorem run: the thread and the SDK receipt command are stood in.
cases.next: Build the accessible overlay; run one live agent turn against a deployed workbench.
